_doc: Team board. clubs = club full names (any match, case-insensitive) that get this board when they are the home side. competition = the competition board whose rows follow the team's. identity = the club row that leads the board: badge + wordmark (recoloured to colours[1]) on colours[0] (primary, secondary - from the game's club data); "repeat", "margin", "wordmark_height" tune it, "manual": true keeps a hand-made club.png. sponsors = ids in config/sponsors/sponsors.json, in order: the club's top four non-gambling partners from its official partners page (2026-10-30).
name: Parramatta Eels
